clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Gann Stonespire turns stolen dwarven plans against Bael Modan. He built the charge to sabotage the dwarves’ flying machine.

When Prospector Khazgorm led the Ironforge excavation into southern Kalimdor, the dwarves drove the Stonespire tauren from their ancestral village and razed their sacred grounds to build Bael Modan. Gann Stonespire reclaimed Khazgorm’s blueprints to avenge his displaced and fallen kin. He studied the plans and assembled a charge with enough force to wreck heavy machinery.
